D: Po faces a peacock warlord with a deadly new weapon and finally learns where he came from.
P: Serve the buns when Po tries to fit them all in his mouth.
S: Steamed daikon and Chinese sausage cakes, fried crisp, oyster sauce

Steamed daikon and rice flour cakes studded with Chinese sausage and shiitake, pan-fried until crisp, with oyster sauce and chilli oil. Grate 800g daikon and simmer in its juice for 10 minutes. Fry 2 diced Chinese sausages, 4 soaked chopped shiitake and 2 spring onions for 3 minutes. Mix into the daikon with 200g rice flour, 200ml water, 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp sugar. Press into an oiled 20cm square tin and steam 45 minutes. Cool completely, then slice into squares and fry in oil 3 minutes a side until crisp. Serve with oyster sauce and chilli oil.
Soft steamed buns filled with sweet red bean paste
Soft steamed buns filled with sweet red bean paste, steamed for 12 minutes until puffy and pillowy.
Lord Shen's fireworks over Gongmen City

Prawns dusted in cornflour and fried crisp, tossed with garlic, chilli, spring onion and a five spice salt that crackles like fireworks. Peel 600g green prawns leaving the tails on and pat dry. Toast 1 tsp Sichuan pepper, crush with 2 tsp salt and half a tsp five spice. Toss the prawns in 60g cornflour. Fry in oil at 180C for 1 to 2 minutes until crisp and drain. Pour off most of the oil and fry 3 sliced garlic cloves, 2 sliced red chillies and 2 spring onions for 30 seconds. Toss in the prawns and 2 tsp of the salt.
M: Chicken broth with shiitake, soft boiled eggs and egg noodles
Fresh egg noodles in a rich chicken broth with bok choy, spring onion, shiitake and a soft egg on top.
Lord Shen and his fireworks cannon

Crisp chicken stir-fried with dried chillies, Sichuan pepper, garlic and roasted peanuts in a sweet, tingly soy and black vinegar glaze, with steamed rice. Cut 700g chicken thigh into 2cm pieces and toss with 1 tbsp soy and 2 tbsp cornflour. Mix 2 tbsp soy, 1 tbsp Chinkiang black vinegar, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp cornflour and 3 tbsp water. Fry the chicken in a hot wok with oil for 5 minutes until crisp, remove. Fry 15 dried chillies and 1 tsp Sichuan pepper for 30 seconds, then 3 garlic cloves and ginger. Return the chicken with the sauce and 60g roasted peanuts and toss. Serve with rice.
W: Steamed buns shaped like peaches, filled with sweet red bean paste
Steamed buns shaped like peaches and tinted pink at the tip, filled with sweet lotus or red bean paste.
K: Smoked plum and hawthorn drink sweetened with rock sugar

Chinese sour plum drink brewed with smoked plums, hawthorn and osmanthus, sweetened with rock sugar and served icy cold, sweet, sour and smoky. Rinse 6 dried smoked plums (wumei) and 15g dried hawthorn slices and soak in 1.5L water for 30 minutes. Bring to the boil and simmer 40 minutes. Add 80g rock sugar and stir until dissolved, then take off the heat and stir in 1 tsp dried osmanthus. Steep 10 minutes, strain and chill well. Serve over ice with a little extra osmanthus on top.

Fry the finely diced smoked tofu, the chopped soaked shiitake and the sliced spring onions in a little oil for 3 minutes.
Mix into the daikon with the rice flour, the water, the salt and the sugar.
Press into an oiled 20cm square tin and steam 45 minutes.
Cool completely, then slice into squares and fry in oil 3 minutes a side until crisp.
Serve with the vegetarian mushroom oyster sauce and chilli oil.

s.note: Soft steamed buns filled with sweet red bean paste
s.how: Mix 400g flour, 7g dried yeast, 40g sugar and 220ml warm milk into a smooth dough and prove 1 hour. Divide into 12, fill each with a spoon of red bean paste (300g total) and pinch closed. Prove 20 minutes, then steam 12 minutes until puffed.

m.note: Chicken broth with shiitake, soft boiled eggs and egg noodles
m.how: Simmer 1.5L chicken stock with 150g sliced shiitake for 10 minutes. Boil 4 eggs for 6 minutes, cool and peel. Cook 400g egg noodles and divide into 4 bowls, add 2 halved bok choy blanched in the broth, ladle over the stock and top with halved eggs and sliced spring onion.

w.note: Steamed buns shaped like peaches, filled with sweet red bean paste
w.how: Make a dough of 300g flour, 5g yeast, 30g sugar and 170ml warm water and prove 1 hour. Shape 10 balls around red bean paste (250g total), pinch a point and score a crease like a peach. Steam 12 minutes, then dab the tips with a little red colouring.
